article.description: Washington Wizards (4-6, ninth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Detroit Pistons (6-3, third in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Washington faces Detroit on 3-game skid
article.story: Washington Wizards (4-6, ninth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Detroit Pistons (6-3, third in the Eastern Conference) Detroit; Monday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Pistons -10.5; over/under is 218.5 BOTTOM LINE: Washington comes into the matchup with Detroit after losing three games in a row. Detroit went 60-22 overall and 39-13 in Eastern Conference play a season ago. The Pistons shot 48.5% from the field and 35.6% from 3-point range last season. Washington finished 17-65 overall and 11-41 in Eastern Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Wizards averaged 25.0 assists per game on 41.8 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Pistons: Jalen Duren: out (hamstring), Isaiah Joe: out (hip). Wizards: Tristan Vukcevic: out (hip), Jamir Watkins: out for season (acl), Anthony Davis: day to day (ankle), Justin Champagnie: out (foot), Reece Beekman: out (shoulder). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
